programme.title: Aitraaz
programme.desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

programme.title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
programme.desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

programme.title: Dream Girl
programme.desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

programme.title: Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aye
programme.desc: Rahul falls for mentally unstable Pooja, but she dies in an asylum fire. Haunted by her memories, he struggles to move on, trapped between love, loss, and lingering grief.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

programme.title: Karz
programme.desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

programme.title: Kaho Naa Pyar Hai
programme.desc: After Rohit's mysterious death, Sonia relocates to New Zealand to heal. There, she meets Raj-Rohit's lookalike-who helps her uncover the truth behind Rohit's murder.

programme.title: Aap Ki Kasam
programme.desc: A jealous husband leaves his pregnant wife due to false doubts. Years later, he returns broken to their daughter's wedding, finally learning the truth.

programme.title: Vijaypath
programme.desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

programme.title: Ground Zero
programme.desc: BSF officer Dubey leads a two-year probe into the 2001 Parliament attack, uncovering Ghazi Baba as the mastermind and triggering India's biggest anti-terror operation.

programme.title: Sirf Tum
programme.desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

programme.title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
programme.desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

programme.title: Kanyadaan
programme.desc: Married as children, Rekha and Amar are separated by fate. Years later, shocking truths emerge as Rekha discovers Amar's new marriage and Kumar's hidden identity.

programme.title: Kishen Kanhaiya
programme.desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth-one rich, one poor-reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.

programme.title: Crew
programme.desc: Three cabin crew friends find themselves in a tough spot when an unknown schemer throws a wrench in their plans. Can they uncover the truth and save the day?

programme.title: Karan Arjun
programme.desc: Durga's sons, Karan and Arjun, set out to avenge their father's death but are killed by their cruel uncle. Years later, they are reincarnated to deliver justice.

programme.title: Runway 34
programme.desc: Two pilots made a risky landing in Thiruvananthapuram due to bad weather. Trouble begins when aviation authorities investigate the incident, uncovering deeper issues.

programme.title: Sam Bahadur
programme.desc: Sam Manekshaw, one of India's most decorated army officers, served for over four decades, fought five wars, and became the first Indian officer to be promoted to Field Marshal.

programme.title: Radhe Shyam
programme.desc: In 1970s Europe, famous palmist Vikramaditya falls in love with Prerana, a doctor. But their relationship is shaken by his strong belief in destiny and her serious illness.

programme.title: Heropanti 2
programme.desc: Babloo, a brilliant hacker, must find Laila, the evil genius behind a massive cyber-crime. Can Babloo stop Laila's nefarious plans before it's too late? Time is of the essence!

programme.title: Saawan Ko Aane Do
programme.desc: Rejected by his lover's rich father, poor Birju returns years later as a successful singer to seek the father's approval.

programme.title: Loafer
programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man, is framed for a gangster's murder. With no support from his family, he must fight alone to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Dunki
programme.desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

programme.title: Ghatak: Lethal
programme.desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

programme.title: Gadar 2
programme.desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

programme.title: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
programme.desc: Ganga, a kind-hearted villager raised by foster parents, returns to his biological family in the city but struggles to adjust to modern life and its contrasting values.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Tigers : Can A Salesman Be A Hero
programme.desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

programme.title: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
programme.desc: City boy Ram falls for village girl Sona, raised by her strict brother Raghuveer. After Ram's mother insults Sona, Raghuveer challenges Ram to prove he's worthy of marrying her.

programme.title: Waqt-The Race Against Time
programme.desc: Ishwar, facing terminal illness, decides to kick his son out to teach him responsibility. It's a tough love lesson that sparks growth and unexpected challenges.

programme.title: Dil Chahta Hai
programme.desc: Three inseparable friends drift apart after college-Akash moves to Australia, Sameer chases love, and Siddharth immerses in art-each following a different path.

programme.title: Dhadak
programme.desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

programme.title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
